sentences.text: 1. The case of the petitioners is that the land measuring 19 Guntas in Survey No.18/2B of Obalapura Village, Thyamagondlu Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District belonging to the family of the petitioners was acquired for the purpose of respondent No.2 - Karnataka Industrial Area Development Board and an award has been passed in this regard.
The prayer of the petitioners is that a consent award should be passed instead of a general award in respect of the property acquired.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.3 upon instructions submits that as stated by the petitioners themselves, there are other claimants other than the petitioners who belong to their own family entitled to the compensation and if every person were to come and make one request,
the case of the petitioners will be considered.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that all the persons of the family will give the necessary consent NC: 2024:KHC:26056 and respondent No.3 may be directed to consider their case in accordance with law.

Hence, the following:-
ORDER i. The impugned general award dated 27.12.2022 in proceedings No.PLJr/J JP/ 1199/2022-23 passed by the respondent No.3 at Annexure-'A' insofar as it relates to the petitioners' land is concerned is set aside.
ii. Respondent No.3 is directed to consider the request of the petitioners for award of compensation by way of an agreement under Section 29(2) of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board Act, 1966, provided all the concerned persons with regard to the property gives their consent; and pass necessary orders within a period of three months after the consent is given by all the concerned persons.

sentences.text: Respondent No.3 is at liberty to withdraw the amount that has been deposited by it pursuant to the general award before the jurisdictional Court.

iv. It is needless to state that if all the concerned persons do not give their consent and or if there is a dispute as to the ownership with regard to the land concerned, the general award already passed would stand restored.
v. The Writ Petition is accordingly disposed of.
vi. Ordered accordingly.
